name: The Hidden Logic of Things
tagline: The hidden reasons behind everyday design.
mission: The Hidden Logic of Things explains the documented engineering, history and design decisions hiding inside familiar objects, one strong question at a time.
audience: Global English-speaking general audience, teens through adults; not specifically made for children.

visualRules.thumbnail: one dominant ordinary object plus one highlighted unusual detail; zero to four words; no collage
visualRules.profileMotif: a familiar object silhouette with one amber detail marker on a warm charcoal field
